sal.basis: Bahrain pay is quoted monthly in BHD, tax-free (no personal income tax; Bahrainis pay social-insurance contributions through SIO), as a package (basic + housing and transport allowances). Estimate from general knowledge, not checked against a 2026 salary guide in this run (web search budget used up, page fetches failed): Senior Financial Analyst / Senior FP&A, ~8 yrs, Manama, about BHD 1,100-1,600 a month for expats at banks and large groups, and about BHD 1,300-2,000 for Bahraini nationals at banks, Bapco Energies, Alba, Mumtalakat companies and the CBB. f = 0.05 maps Noura's 26,000 SAR to BHD 1,300 (Fatema's current pay) and the v5 band 34-41k SAR to BHD 1,700-2,050, the upper part of the Bahraini-national range, the same reading as the v5 KSA band. At the exchange rate alone (1 BHD = ~9.97 SAR, both USD-pegged) f would be 0.10; Bahrain pays much less than Riyadh's top employers for this role, so f is half that. Plausible range for f: 0.04-0.06.

rule.en: We skip Bahraini-only roles unless you are Bahraini. If you need a new work visa, we also skip roles that only take candidates already in Bahrain.
rule.ar: نتخطّى الوظائف المخصّصة للبحرينيين إلا إذا كانت جنسيتك بحرينية. وإذا تحتاج تأشيرة عمل جديدة، نتخطّى بعد الوظائف اللي تطلب مرشحين موجودين في البحرين.
rule.fr: Nous écartons les postes réservés aux Bahreïniens si vous n'avez pas cette nationalité. Si vous avez besoin d'un nouveau visa de travail, nous écartons aussi les offres réservées aux candidats déjà présents à Bahreïn.

desc.en: Private employers have Bahrainization targets for their share of Bahraini staff, set by sector and company size, and LMRA applies them when it issues work permits. Tamkeen subsidises Bahraini salaries in the private sector, and government jobs go to Bahrainis first. We only apply to roles marked Bahrainis only if you are Bahraini.
desc.ar: الشركات الخاصة عليها نسب بحرنة حسب القطاع وحجم الشركة، وهيئة تنظيم سوق العمل تطبّقها لما تصدر تصاريح العمل. وتمكين يدعم رواتب البحرينيين في القطاع الخاص، والوظائف الحكومية الأولوية فيها للبحرينيين. وما نقدّم على الوظائف المخصصة للبحرينيين إلا إذا كانت جنسيتك بحرينية.
desc.fr: Les employeurs privés ont des objectifs de bahreïnisation, c'est-à-dire une part de salariés bahreïniens fixée selon le secteur et la taille de l'entreprise, que la LMRA applique lorsqu'elle délivre les permis de travail. Tamkeen subventionne les salaires des Bahreïniens dans le secteur privé, et les emplois publics vont en priorité aux Bahreïniens. Nous ne postulons aux offres réservées aux Bahreïniens que si vous avez la nationalité bahreïnienne.

sensitive.notes: Photo: common on Bahraini and Gulf CVs emailed to recruiters and on Bayt/GulfTalent profiles, but not needed for ATS uploads; we offer it, never require it, and only send it where a form asks. Gender, date of birth and nationality are standard fields on Bahraini employer portals (banks, Bapco Energies, Alba, Gulf Air) and on Bayt and GulfTalent profiles. Nationality also drives Bahrainization ('Bahrainis only' adverts, Tamkeen-supported roles), LMRA work-permit handling and government hiring. Marital status appears on some Gulf CVs and on government forms but is not needed for matching, so we do not ask (conservative, PDPL data minimisation). We never ask for the CPR (national ID) number; employers collect it at offer stage. Labour Law 36/2012 bans wage discrimination on grounds such as sex, origin, language and religion, so we never filter on gender or age, only on work rights and Bahraini-only postings. From general knowledge; not re-verified in this run.

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in Manama. I lead IFRS reporting and budgeting on SAP across business units and own the monthly close for a 40-person function. I built the rolling forecasts and variance analysis that cut our reporting time by a third, and I ran our VAT returns through Bahrain's move to 10%. I am looking for a Senior Financial Analyst or FP&A role in Manama, Muharraq, or remote.
bio.ar: محللة مالية بخبرة 8 سنوات في المنامة. أقود تقارير IFRS والموازنة على SAP عبر وحدات الأعمال، وأملك الإقفال الشهري لإدارة من 40 موظفاً. بنيت التوقعات المتحركة وتحليل الانحرافات اللي قلّصت وقت التقارير بالثلث، وأدرت إقرارات ضريبة القيمة المضافة لما ارتفعت النسبة في البحرين إلى 10%. أبحث عن وظيفة محلل مالي أول أو تخطيط وتحليل مالي في المنامة أو المحرق أو عن بُعد.
bio.fr: Analyste financière avec 8 ans d'expérience à Manama. Je pilote le reporting IFRS et le budget sous SAP pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une fonction de 40 personnes. J'ai mis en place les prévisions glissantes et l'analyse des écarts qui ont réduit d'un tiers notre délai de reporting, et j'ai géré nos déclarations de TVA lors du passage du taux à 10 % à Bahreïn. Je recherche un poste d'analyste financière senior ou en FP&A à Manama, à Muharraq ou en télétravail.

culture.notes: Work week Sun-Thu (Friday-Saturday weekend since 2006); government offices work roughly 7:00-14:15 and many private firms 8:00-17:00, so interviews and deadlines in copy should use Sun-Thu days. Salaries are quoted monthly, tax-free, as a package (basic + housing and transport allowances) and paid monthly through the Wage Protection System; Bahrainis contribute to the state pension through SIO. Notice under Labour Law 36/2012: at least 30 days for indefinite contracts; senior finance contracts often say 1-3 months, so copy should not promise an immediate start. Expats change jobs through LMRA; a move in the first year can need the current employer's consent. CVs: 2 pages, English (an Arabic version helps for government and semi-government roles), with a personal block (nationality, CPR or visa status, often date of birth and photo). Cover letters are rarely required; portals ask screening questions instead. During Ramadan, working hours are cut to 6 a day (36 a week) for Muslim staff. English is the working language in banks and the financial sector; Arabic matters for government and Bahraini-facing roles. Banking is one of the most Bahrainized sectors, and many finance roles are Bahraini-preferred. Recruiters and hiring managers are a mix of Bahrainis and expats (Indian, Arab, Filipino, British).
